name: When is it necessary to replace an entire interior door frame instead of just the door slab?
description: Replace an entire door frame if it's damaged, warped, or out of square, or if upgrading door size or type, as a faulty frame prevents proper door function.

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to replace an entire interior door frame instead of just the door slab?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is necessary to replace an entire interior door frame when the existing frame is damaged, warped, or out of square, preventing proper door operation. Signs include doors that stick, don't close securely, or have large gaps around the edges. Replacing only the door slab into a compromised frame will not resolve these issues and can lead to continued problems. Additionally, if you are upgrading to a different size door or need improved soundproofing, a new frame designed for the specific door and its features (like a solid-core door's weight) might be essential. Our team assesses frame integrity to recommend the most effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace an entire door frame if it's damaged, warped, or out of square, or if upgrading door size or type, as a faulty frame prevents proper door function.
